name: TPM backend
responsibility: Create and use an ECDSA P-256 child key under the owner storage primary.
description: Uses tss-esapi. Recreates the deterministic ECC P-256 storage primary on each use, loads the saved public and private blobs, and signs an external digest with a null hashcheck ticket. The key is fixedTPM, fixedParent, userWithAuth and noDA, with an empty auth value. No persistent handles.
